title: Tractian with Native SQL Access
summary: Tractian's platform now offers native SQL access. See how you can turn your maintenance data into live dashboards and insights in under a week.
body_markdown:
*No more hassles with integrations, your native database plug-in is here.*


When we started building Tractian's platform, our goal was clear: create a platform powerful enough for enterprise needs, yet accessible and intuitive enough for the teams on the ground. Today, I’m proud to share a major milestone in that vision: Tractian now **offer native SQL access to its database** .


This isn’t just a new feature. It’s a game-changer for any organization that needs to extract value from its maintenance data quickly, securely, and on its own terms.


### Why We Built the SQL Connector


For years, maintenance teams have been stuck between two painful choices:


1. **Siloed data** locked inside black-box software with limited reporting options.
2. **Complex integrations** that require months of development, custom APIs, and constant IT involvement.


The SQL Connector eliminates that tradeoff. It gives your team **real-time, read-only access to your full dataset** through a secure, single-tenant SQL database. It’s the same architecture we use internally for analytics, now available to your team.


### Built for the Real-World Maintenance Stack


Most maintenance platform vendors offer limited exports or slow API access. Our approach is different by design.


- **No middlemen.** No ETL scripts, no middleware, no delays.
- **No IT headaches.** Forget on-premise complexity or expensive connectors.
- **No waiting.** Your data is ready for Power BI, Excel, Tableau, Looker, or any SQL-compatible tool, in minutes.[Check here all the systems we integrate with.](https://tractian.com/en/solutions/integrations)


Whether you’re a CIO or a data-driven Plant Manager, the possibilities are endless:


- Build live dashboards that combine maintenance data with production, inventory, or financial metrics.
- Run custom reports without waiting for vendor support or custom builds.
- Automate your spreadsheets with direct SQL queries without CSV exports.


And perhaps most importantly, **you own your data experience** , without giving up security, performance, or flexibility.


We designed this feature with real-world industrial and enterprise operations in mind. It works with:


- **ERPs like SAP, Oracle, Infor, Dynamics 365**
- **Business intelligence tools like Power BI, Excel, Looker, Tableau**
- **Fleet and asset systems like Samsara, CatVision, and FuelCloud**


It’s not just that Tractian works with your tech stack, it fits **into your data strategy** .


### What’s Next


We believe every modern maintenance platform should empower users, not lock away their data.


From customizable indicators to AI-powered diagnostics, we’ll keep building toward the same north star: **real-time visibility, faster decisions, and zero IT bottlenecks.**


And if you already are a[Tractian](https://tractian.com/en/solutions/cmms) customer on our Enterprise plan, the SQL Connector is available now as an add-on. Talk to our team and we’ll show you how your data flows live in less than a week.
